purpose: Fix the n=64 analysis before the exact field exists, so that neither the budget grid, the primary metric, nor the baseline set can be chosen after seeing the outcome.

primary_metric.name: exact_decision_regret
primary_metric.definition: R_K(x) = max over the complete neighborhood of the exact effect, minus the best exact effect among the K candidates the policy folds
primary_metric.rationale: exact-best identity is the wrong headline: a near miss that costs 0.002 is not a failure, and the pilot showed the loss distribution is what separates policies

frozen_baselines.sequence_only: TopB of the teacher's matched sequence-only ablation

hybrid_union.form: Top(B-m) of cached-parent, unioned with Top(m) of sequence-only, truncated to B
hybrid_union.rationale: the pilot showed the sequence branch may act as a hedge against catastrophic misses rather than as a second oracle; it must be judged at MATCHED total exact budget, on tail risk, not on hit rate

frozen_baselines.one_backward_gradient: TopB of the frozen gradient field, retained only as a sealed negative control
frozen_baselines.random_control: uniform without replacement, 20 draws per anchor

baseline_comparison_rule: every policy is charged the same total exact budget B and compared on E[R_B], CVaR95(R_B) and max R_B before any statement about hit rate

event_definitions: Y_K = 1[R_K > epsilon] for epsilon in the tail thresholds
failure_detection.evaluation: ROC AUC and precision-recall average precision for predicting Y_K, not correlation against log rank

competing_hypotheses.H_unreliable: higher structure-versus-sequence disagreement implies the cached field is unreliable
competing_hypotheses.H_informative: higher disagreement instead means the parent geometry is contributing real constraint, and agreement is what signals the structure branch adds nothing

failure_detection.confirmation_rule: any detector that looks good on these 64 components is exploratory and must be confirmed on a fresh, disjoint component batch before it is claimed or used to set a budget

mechanism_diagnosis.question: does the cached-parent field fail exactly when the best mutation leaves the parent's structural basin
measurements_on_the_exact_best_mutant_ag: per-residue exposure change at and around the mutated site
mechanism_diagnosis.rationale: these require the mutant's own exact structure and therefore cannot inform a pre-fold budget; they exist to explain the regime, not to predict it

prohibited: choosing the budget grid, the primary metric, the epsilon thresholds or the baseline set after seeing the scale exact field
tuning any hybrid m, detector threshold or feature subset on the scale exact field and then reporting it as confirmatory
evaluating, scoring, inspecting or selecting on the repository test split
comparing logits produced under different batchings; the canonical scorer tuple must be identical across the cached-parent, exact and sequence-only fields
